Subject: Your land dispute matter

Dear Ms. Srivastava,

Thank you for meeting us on 19 December 2022 about your dispute with Kavya Pawar. As we understand it, relatives dispute who owns the ancestral land.

Our advice is to trace the chain of title through the mutation entries. Please collect the mutation entries, the partition deed and the old sale deeds and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹85,20,000.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
